jobs.description: Start each day with a fresh session (needs claude in the Docker image's tmux restart loop); the SessionEnd hook writes the notes
Commit, pull and push the workspace; the session only hears about failures

steps.bash: out=$( (git add -A && (git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -qm "backup $(date +%F)") && git pull -q --rebase && git push -q) 2>&1 ) && exit 1; echo "$out"

jobs.description: Webhook-only example: POST /api/jobs/doorbell/run from Home Assistant

steps.prompt: Doorbell: {output}. Announce it on the speakers.
